top.line: Storm Charles, part two: what the site grew on 11 and 12 November, by spoken briefs.
top.para: Transport, flights, a model router, an AWS plan, the accounts.

in-short.line: Transport in ten minutes, flights against the wind, one router, an AWS plan, 3.84 billion tokens, an empty account.

listening.line: Each sentence recorded with its time; an agent with its own key working on it within minutes.

transport.line: Ten operators read from 10:35; the Lisbon Metro stopped at 12:08 on its terms; an API too.

flights.line: Planes against the wind, moved to adsb.lol over a licence, inside 500 free requests a day.

router.line: Four collectors on open-weight models through OpenRouter, every call traced and measured.

aws.line: An AgentCore plan with nothing deployed and no AWS account, on purpose.
aws.para: A plan a person can approve.

cost.line: 3.84 billion tokens, 98.7% re-reading; about 2.50 dollars a day of model calls on a 20 dollar cap.

empty.line: The model account ran empty: 3,557 calls refused, and nothing else stopped.

down.line: Down to the main priorities just before 01:00, the hand brake at 15:15, observability last.

limits.line: The site's own figures; small-sample comparisons; nothing deployed on AWS.

sources.line: The Storm Charles repository and live site, re-read on 17 November 2026.
